title: Minimax Regression Discontinuity for Sparse Distribution-Valued Outcomes at Finite Resolution
banked_reason: iid R3D draws lack the stable marked decoder; no transfer theorem or real deployed marked-channel setting is named.
gap_reasons: iid R3D draws lack the stable marked decoder; no transfer theorem or real deployed marked-channel setting is named.

Known, uniformly nonvanishing signals for conditionally independent binary probes of every coordinate of an infinite latent sequence are load-bearing, while the asserted questionnaire/instrument examples do not establish that this calibration model is realistic.
A verbal centered ‘local-polynomial influence process’ does not define residuals, weights, variance estimation, or endpoints, while H requires exact all-n honest coverage.
proof_attempt_summary: Four proposal revisions tried to turn the presolved sparse-within-unit R3D rate into a field-tier all-regime minimax and honest-band frontier. The final root change replaced the iid tuple-mixture experiment by calibrated marked binary probes and assumed the desired coefficient-tail rate, while explicitly leaving the true iid R3D exponent open; the validity gate therefore classified the result as kernel substitution. A future attempt would need a genuine complete-tuple observation modulus and matching estimator/band directly in the iid R3D experiment, not the marked-channel surrogate.
tldr:
The flagship result is a standalone complete-mixture regression-discontinuity frontier. A latent indexed functional has polynomially decaying unresolved coordinates, each resolution reveals a nested marked tuple, and the causal contrast is localized at a sharp cutoff. Matching minimax risk and all-honest band width equal \(n^{-s/(2s+1)}+m^{-
u}\): bounded resolution leaves a positive floor, intermediate resolution is governed by \(m^{-
u}\), and \(m\asymp n^{s/[
u(2s+1)]}\) is the smallest oracle order. The estimator is data-measurable, the band uses explicitly declared independent Gaussian multipliers, and a smooth unresolved-tail pair supplies the converse. Distribution-valued R3D is a worked specialization: direct latent distributions identify the LAQTE under two potential-curve continuity conditions, finite iid tuples remain partially identifying, and their sharp operator exponent is exposed as an open question rather than attributed to prior R3D theory.
gap: Complete-mixture papers study nonidentification or global mixing-law loss, functional-data papers study additive point-identified measurements, and RD papers localize directly observed scalar or distributional functionals. None gives a generic matching two-resolution frontier with a finite-resolution identification floor and an RD boundary term.
fill: The project proves the frontier \(n^{-s/(2s+1)}+m^{-\nu}\), constructs a decoded local-polynomial estimator and a randomized bias-aware band, certifies the lower bound with explicit indistinguishable tail alternatives, and uses sparse distribution-valued R3D as the worked operator-specialization problem.
